description: Swap and bridge API for wallets, apps and bots: one REST call (GET /v1/quote) returns the best price across EVM networks, Solana, Bitcoin, TON, Tron, Sui, Hyperliquid and Cosmos networks, and the one transaction that makes it. 0.1% router fee; the integrator adds their own fee (0 to 0.9%), paid in the same transaction. TypeScript SDK (@soheil-fi/router) and an MCP server (no key needed) with token search, Soheil Guard token checks and swaps paid by deposit.
rules: Keep the secret API key (sk_…) on your server and send it in the x-api-key header; only a publishable key (pk_…) may be used in a web page.
Amounts are strings in the token's smallest unit (100 USDC is "100000000"); an EVM network's own coin is 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000.
Approve exactly fromAmount to the quote's approvalAddress (none when selling the coin), then send transactionRequest unchanged from fromAddress.
Ask for a fresh quote when validUntil has passed; set priceOnly=true for prices you only show, and quote again before the user signs.
toAmountMin is the least the recipient gets: show it next to toAmount.
To pay a fixed price in another token, ask with toAmount instead of fromAmount (a swap on one EVM network): the quote's fromAmount is what to send and toAmountMin is never below the price.
Follow a sent trade with GET /v1/status until its status is DONE, FAILED, REFUNDED or NOT_OURS.
